findings: SBI's October 30 capital/business alliance with SMBC Group includes a 5% SMBC equity stake in SBI Startale Marketing, the JPYSC promotion JV; investment amount undisclosed.

SBI's SBI-Sygnum-Azimut Digital Asset Opportunity Fund decided to invest in PhotonPay. Amount undisclosed. SBI reports USD65B annualized total payment volume as of August 2026, 60+ currencies, 100+ remittance routes and 33 licences; the TPV covers all rails, not stablecoin-only volume.
PhotonPay conducted a Mastercard AI-agent payment PoC in May 2026; this is not production and does not establish XRP settlement.

SBI and Startale joined Open Standard with named participants including Coinbase, Mastercard, Visa, Stripe and BlackRock. They will explore a JPYSC-OUSD pilot; this is shared consortium membership and pilot exploration, not a direct Coinbase contract or production settlement.
SBI, Startale and BlackRock signed an MOU to explore tokenized MMF and JPYSC interoperability; the specific fund, network and production volumes are not disclosed.

JPYSC issuance was approximately JPY20.1B on September 7; SBI Shinsei Trust Bank began investing JPY10B in short-term JGBs; JPYSC lending applications were approximately JPY6.9B, not accepted loan balances.
JPYSC remains account-only at VCTRADE; external wallet transfers/public-chain circulation are planned subject to legal/tax treatment and supervisory confirmation. No XRPL route is live.
SBI invested approximately USD50M in Startale Group in March 2026. This is equity capital, not JPYSC reserve capital or XRP purchases.
